title: OpenCode Slash Command Format
description: JSON Schema for OpenCode Slash Commands - markdown files with YAML frontmatter stored in .opencode/command/

description.description: Brief description of what the command does (shown in TUI)

template.description: The prompt text sent to the LLM when executed. Required field. Supports placeholders: $ARGUMENTS, $1-$9, !`command`, @filename

agent.description: Specifies which agent executes the command

model.description: Overrides default model for this command (e.g., 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6')

subtask.description: Forces subagent invocation behavior when true

frontmatter.description: Run tests for a specific file
frontmatter.template: Run the tests for $1 and report the results

examples.content:
# Test Runner Command

Executes tests for the specified file and provides a detailed report.

frontmatter.template:
Review the following code for best practices:

@$1
